title: Open prep: skill-ladder exposures 2x/week + overhead mobility
what: training.yaml: lower_force gets an 'Open skills' block (olympic ladder 4x3 + kipping ladder 3x20 s) after the primer; squat_hyrox gets olympic positions (4x3) before the squat and an overhead-ladder item (3x8 @ 3 RIR) after it; upper_skill_metcon adds an overhead-ladder item (3x8 @ 3 RIR) and drops face pulls (keeps it under the 120-min cap); sprint_upper gets a kipping-ladder block (3x20 s); upper_lift warm-up adds PVC pass-throughs. movement_progressions.yaml: kipping rung 0 lists hollow_hold and arch_hold (it listed no exercises, so the kipping ladder could never log an exposure or advance); exercises.yaml tags both as kipping rung 0.
why: Athlete wants Block 1 to prepare as much as possible for the 2027 Open. The baseline shows movement access is the limiter, not strength: overhead, olympic and kipping are all at rung 0, and Open staples need overhead 1-3 (wall balls, thrusters, DB snatch, wall walks), kipping 3 (T2B/C2B) and olympic 2 (power clean). Each rung needs 3 clean exposures and 14-21 days (+ a form check on the top rungs), and the old templates gave these ladders 0-1 exposures a week. Now each gets ~2/week. Best case with every exposure clean: wall balls ~early Dec, thrusters ~late Dec, T2B/C2B and DB snatch ~mid/late Jan. Confidence: moderate (depends on clean exposures and form checks). Athlete approved in chat 2026-11-22.
